description: The cloud machine setup and the pinned toolchain (engine-cloud, U4, D-068, D-069 item 3): the project PostgreSQL, downloads, setup locks and the egress proxy defaults.

cloud.bootstrap_python_minimum.description: Oldest Python (major, minor) the setup accepts to run the toolchain installer before the pinned Python exists.

cloud.download_backoff_s.description: Seconds before the second try of a toolchain download; each next pause is twice the one before (1, 2, 4 s).

cloud.download_chunk_bytes.description: Chunk size for toolchain downloads and checksum reads.

cloud.download_timeout_s.description: Seconds one toolchain download may take.

cloud.download_tries.description: Tries of one toolchain download before setup fails with 'download failed' (a runner's cold task meets a network that is not ready).

cloud.postgres_binaries.description: PostgreSQL programs the toolchain exposes as shims in .toolchain/bin.

cloud.postgres_database.description: Database the toolchain PostgreSQL guarantees at startup (each checkout then gets its own tower_test_<hash> database).

cloud.postgres_encoding.description: Encoding of the cluster and of psql clients.

cloud.postgres_host.description: Address the project-local PostgreSQL listens on and every client of it connects to.

cloud.postgres_locale.description: Locale of the cluster created by initdb.

cloud.postgres_lock_path.description: Lock that serialises concurrent startups of the project PostgreSQL (shared by the session uid and uid 0).

cloud.postgres_log_tail_chars.description: Longest server-log line quoted in a startup error.

cloud.postgres_port.description: Default port of the project-local PostgreSQL; the OU_POSTGRES_PORT environment variable overrides it for one shell.

cloud.postgres_query_timeout_s.description: Seconds one psql probe may run before it counts as down.

cloud.postgres_ready_wait_s.description: Seconds pg_ctl waits for the server to accept connections.

cloud.postgres_role.description: Superuser role the cluster is initialised with and every cloud client connects as.

cloud.postgres_socket_permissions.description: Unix socket mode of the cluster when uid 0 hands the server to the service user, so the session uid can reach it.

cloud.postgres_test_settings.description: name=value settings setup.sh applies to the project-local test cluster (ALTER SYSTEM, reload). CREATE/DROP DATABASE each force a checkpoint; with durability off the checkpoint no longer waits on the disk behind a loaded gate (GX-29, C1 cold gate: claude-session teardown over 30 s). The cluster holds throwaway data only.

cloud.proxy_direct_hosts.description: Loopback names appended to NO_PROXY when an egress proxy is set, so local services stay direct.

cloud.proxy_silenced_warning.description: Node warning code silenced when NODE_USE_ENV_PROXY is enabled for the egress proxy.

cloud.root_gate_checkout_root.description: Slot checkout root for gates run as uid 0, a place the unprivileged uids of script tests can traverse.

cloud.setup_lock_path.description: Lock that serialises concurrent runs of the cloud setup.

cloud.setup_log_path.description: Log the cloud setup writes its quiet steps to.

cloud.setup_log_tail_lines.description: Lines of the setup log printed when a setup step fails.

cloud.test_db_hosts.description: Hosts of the local PostgreSQL in which ou_test_db_ensure may create a checkout's test database (D-064 (b)); a TEST_DATABASE_URL on any other server is refused. Moved from scripts/lib/gate-isolation.sh with the function (D-322).

cloud.test_db_refused_status.description: Exit status of ou_test_db_ensure when TEST_DATABASE_URL is not a local PostgreSQL database of cloud.test_db_hosts (D-064 (b)); distinct from 1, a database that could not be created. Moved from scripts/lib/gate-isolation.sh with the function (D-322).
